notes: Read SKILL.md (536 lines) and references/log-aggregation.md, log-correlation-tracing.md, log-format.md, log-sampling-strategies.md, log-shipping.md, logging-aggregation.md, logging-architecture.md, structured-logging-implementation.md in full. Guidance for ECS-style JSON-lines logging: schema, level discipline, Pino/Serilog/Zerolog/structlog configs, correlation-ID and OpenTelemetry context propagation, PII redaction, sampling, and Vector/Fluentd shipping and retention.

No commands, installs, credentials, or network access by the agent; everything is sample code and config for the user's own services. SKILL.md:46 asks for terse output with no preamble, which only shapes reply style.

Caveats in sample code (not exclusion-grade, but users should know): the redact() helper in SKILL.md:262-268 returns after the first matching pattern, so a string containing both an email and a token only gets the email masked, and the '$1' replacement refers to a non-capturing group; SKILL.md:253 suggests storing a 'reversible hash' of PII, which is effectively reversible PII retention; the X-Debug-Log header (SKILL.md:129, log-sampling-strategies.md:148) lets any client switch on debug logging unless restricted to trusted callers; Vector/Fluentd examples ship to plaintext http://elasticsearch:9200 and use timberio/vector:latest. SKILL.md:414-537 is generic boilerplate (observer pattern, deployment checklist, STRIDE). The 'devops-observability' handoff is an optional pointer to a skill not bundled here.
